Chapter 6720: Happiness

Chapter 6720: Happiness

This red tribulation was a core curse ready to destroy anyone ascending. The heaven didn’t permit life creation or this reversal process.

The new item, Death Scroll, took the reversal process one level higher, further infuriating the high heaven.

When the new page was flipped on the nine treasures, Death Coffin should have changed as well but somehow remained. Worst of all, after changing it, he morphed into Life Scroll.

Although this treasure possessed two sides, death was still the core principle - its true meaning. His action altered the very nature of this treasure in an attempt to bring someone back.

This was one level higher than what the lord did, resembling creation more than reversal.

The blood-red tribulation flooded down like a breached dam toward Li Qiye, wanting to destroy Li Qiye and all of Three Immortals. Destruction seemed inevitable.

“Scram!” Li Qiye punched the sky with his supreme will, not allowing the tribulation to descend.

His will was strong enough to overwhelm and crush primordial immortals at this point.

“Bam!” The red tribulation dispersed into smoke and peace returned.

Spectators couldn’t believe their eyes since he had just suppressed the high heaven’s tribulation. The strongest cultivators had never seen anything like this before.

“Buzz.” Finally, Death Scroll turned into Life Scroll with boundless life force. Death flickered like a candle on the statue, eventually snuffed out.

The vitality within the statue became vast beyond imagination. The whole world felt its presence. Flowers, grasses, and trees grew vigorously. Living beings obtained a stronger life essence and their illnesses vanished. Those on the brink of life and death had their lifespan extended for years.

“Buzz.” The process of stone turning into flesh and blood was clear for all to see.

“This is...” She stared at her new body in disbelief.

“Miss Qin, His Majesty has granted you life.” Liu Chuqing smiled.

“Thank you for your generosity, Your Majesty. My blade is yours.” Qin Jianyao knelt.

“Stay with Chuqing.” Li Qiye said.

“I obey.” She continued kneeling.

At this time, Supreme Black Ancestor arrived to join them.

“Haha, My Lord, congratulations, it seems you’re the high heaven now.” Black laughed.

“Is it time to curry favor?” Chuqing smiled.

“You know me best, Your Majesty.” He answered shamelessly.

“I’m not the high heaven but out of consideration for your past contributions, I will satisfy your demands. Within limits, of course.” Li Qiye said.

All eyes were on Black since this statement alone carried incredible weight.

“It’s that easy?” Black was surprised to hear this.

“Of course, I am leaving soon so I will grant you a fortune.” Li Qiye said.

“Hehe, then any demand?” Black’s round eyes lit up.

“Depends on what it is.” Li Qiye said.

“Wow, my heart blossoms with joy, I can’t come up with a request so fast though.” Black’s gleefully spun three times in place.

“His Majesty has no time to wait for you.” Chuqing said: “Do you want to become an immortal?”

Only Chuqing here could speak on Li Qiye’s behalf.

Black calmed down and pondered in silence. Li Qiye sat down next to him and patted his head: “You don’t want to become an immortal?”

“Those who have yet to become immortal think immortals are free from all worries.” Black sighed.

“Not to mention those born as a mortal, even the immortals at birth have their burden.” Li Qiye said.

“I don’t wish to become an immortal. That will be my limit, not comparable to Her Majesty, Desolate Ancestor, and definitely not you, My Lord.” Black said.

“Rather picky.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, still have to cultivate and struggle after becoming an immortal, the dao is so lonely and unreachable.” Black said.

“That’s just how it is.” Li Qiye said.

“I'd rather be happy.” Black said: “Joy without distractions for as long as I live. What do you think, My Lord?”

“Happiness, I see.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, I was so happy when I was a calf.” Black said while reminiscing.
